info.title: Buildto V2 API — Foundation
info.description: Buildto V2.1 marketplace API: warehouse fulfillment, COD finance verification, GST snapshot invoices, customer care, and supplier financial reconciliation. Finance settlement proposals are held until independent finance attestation; posted accrual memo journals do not establish bank-held funds or execute payouts. Refunds and legal credit notes remain separate gated flows.
